verse.verse_1: Say: "I seek refuge with the Lord of Al-Falaq,"
verse.verse_2: "From the evil of what He has created,"
verse.verse_3: "And from the evil of the Ghasiq when Waqab,"
verse.verse_4: "And from the evil of the blowers in knots,"
verse.verse_5: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."
